title: Google Labs DESIGN.md spec with lint and diff CLI
summary: Google Labs repo defining DESIGN.md: YAML token front matter plus markdown rationale so coding agents persist a lintable design system, with npx lint for WCAG contrast and diff for CI governance.
question_it_answers: What is the canonical DESIGN.md file format and how do you lint or diff design tokens for coding agents?

claims.text: DESIGN.md combines YAML front matter tokens with markdown prose so agents get exact values and application rationale.
claims.evidence: Tokens give agents exact values; prose tells them why and how to apply them.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: CLI supports lint for WCAG contrast and token validation plus diff to compare design system versions.
claims.evidence: CLI: `npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md` — WCAG contrast, token validation
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

judge_hints.why_must_read: Research ties DESIGN.md to downstream extractors and BESS marketing use cases.
